notablePrerequisites: You control two or more Goblins.
description:
Cast Squee by paying {3} plus commander tax if applicable
When Squee enters, Mirror of Life Trapping and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Goblin you control.
Resolve the Mirror of Life Trapping trigger, exiling Squee.
Repeat.
